data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100. This risks lower future income, not guaranteed optimal recovery. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
